verdict.rationale: Eqvista's marketing describes a "secure built-in data room" for diligence materials (eqvista-docs-24). It also claims advanced permissions over who can view sensitive equity data (eqvista-docs-23), shareholder equity-visibility settings (eqvista-docs-16), and centralized document and stakeholder access (eqvista-docs-6). However, these are one-line claims with no support article showing how the data room works. Missing for 10: documentation of data-room setup and per-user or per-folder permissions for external counsel and investors, evidence that cap table views can be shared inside the data room alongside documents, access logging or audit trail, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
